task_input_identity.need: Determine whether the verification map already covers satisfaction of one producer result selected by an immutable external landing claim before consumer acceptance.

owner_boundary.edge_selection_owner: The installed external supervisor owns the complete DAG edge set and binds each exact producer result in the immutable landing claim.
owner_boundary.readback_owner: The existing landing owner returns one provider_readback next action owned by GitHub. Its next.requests includes the consumer GETs and indexed dependency_N_issue/pr/commit/branch/ancestry/run/jobs GETs.
owner_boundary.continuation: Obtain every GET named by the current landing.next.requests in one readback and execute the current landing.next.argv unchanged. The exact landing operation and argv must come from current owner output, not be reconstructed.
owner_boundary.validation_owner: dependency_binding.py validates every supervisor-selected result at the existing landing validate_snapshot boundary before consumer acceptance. The repository profile and landing state machine remain the only consumer acceptance and effect owners.
owner_boundary.effect_authority: This map/recipe is non-authorizing. Provider merge/closure and landing require separate existing authorization and fresh provider readback.

decision_basis: The feature index explicitly maps Cross-repository delivery to fixture discrimination of externally selected dependency satisfaction through indexed landing.next.requests dependency_N_* entries.

The selected recipe says a supervisor-bound dependency is part of the same landing.next.requests map, not a separate command or Agent-selected gate, and says there is no dependency flag or correction guess.

The system contract's Cross-repository dependency satisfaction section matches every requested evidence dimension: completed Issue closure; merged PR identity; ordered merge parents and exact tree; merged revision identical to or ancestor of producer main; successful exact-head workflow run, jobs and required steps.

dependency_binding.requests projects seven indexed read-only producer GETs, while dependency_binding.validate checks all selected results. dependency_binding.py explicitly owns no edge registry, effect, scheduler, retry loop or lifecycle state.

landing.provider_next merges dependency requests beside consumer requests. landing.validate_snapshot invokes validate_dependency before consumer PR/Issue/run/job acceptance checks; landing.start invokes validate_snapshot before creating a checkpoint.

The requirement is therefore mapped to the existing Cross-repository delivery feature and existing landing owner path. Adding another feature, CLI flag or registry would duplicate or violate the documented ownership boundary.
